added_lines: . only a limited number of seats available; full costs €2,250. contact fr. mark to find out more. parish list of the dead as we approach november, we compile our own individual list of our beloved dead and add them to the parish list of the dead 2026. the parish list of the dead envelopes are available in the churches, in your box of parish envelopes or simply write on a plain envelope parish list of the dead and enclose your name, address, offering and list of beloved dead. please return to the parochial house / office or put into the collection bags at weekend masses. on friday 6th november at 7:30pm in st. colmcille’s church a special mass of memory will be offered, at which we will think especially of the parishioners whom we have buried since this time last year. we invite their families to join us for this memorial, as we recognise their grief and support them with our prayers. we also invite other parishioners who may have lost loved ones and celebrated their funerals elsewhere. please come and join with us as we pray for the gentle repose of their souls in the eternal love and mercy of god. ministers of the word for november (weekend masses) sat 6.30pm: aoife brady sun 9.30am: valerie o’sullivan sun 12.00pm: john griffin ministers of the word for november (10am weekday masses) frances monaghan (2-7 nov);
